sample_unit: matched pairs of AI-generated and provider-authored admission H&P notes

links.outcome: CDI team adjudication of AI-identified secondary diagnoses in AI-drafted admission notes
links.effect: CDI team adjudicated 104 AI-identified secondary diagnoses, 97% (101/104) supported for documentation; principal diagnosis concordance 91% (20/22), AI misclassified principal diagnosis in two cases.
links.quote: The CDI team adjudicated 104 AI-identified secondary diagnoses, of which 97% (101/104) were supported for documentation.

unlisted_practices: Using AI-generated admission note drafts to surface undocumented secondary diagnoses for clinical documentation improvement

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance of generative AI in drafting admission notes compared to provider-authored notes via retrospective chart review and expert adjudication, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
